display.title: Nether Meridian
display.description: Carry the atlas beyond the Overworld and chart a Nether Fortress bearing.

tracker.text: Bring 3 blaze rods for heat-proof bearings.
tracker.complete_text: The blaze rods are ready for the meridian.

tracker.text: Bring 8 Nether Wart from the fortress route.
tracker.complete_text: The Nether Wart is sealed for study.

travel.text: Reach the Nether Fortress near {target_x}, {target_z} in {target_dimension}.

proof.text: Bring blaze rods and Nether Wart from the fortress route.

return.text: Return to the cartographer with the Nether meridian.

start: The atlas survived the Overworld. Now it needs a meridian from the Nether, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring blaze rods and Nether Wart.
reminder: Nether Fortress near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring 3 blaze rods and 8 Nether Wart without letting the map burn.
turn_in: The ink warped, but the line held. We have a road through heat now.
already_completed: The Nether meridian is already drawn.
unavailable: The atlas needs one Overworld branch finished before it can survive the Nether.
inactive: The Nether page is not open right now.
missing_target: The supplies need a fortress bearing behind them.
missing_proof: Bring blaze rods from the fortress route before I trust the meridian.
locate_failed: The Nether mark refuses to settle from here.
